text:
mike_sales: Emergency - client (Aurora Retail) POC hitting 503s on /v1/generate at the start of a live demo. Demo in 20m. Customers seeing "503 Service Unavailable".

nina_se: Any deploys recently? 503 could be an upstream model worker crash or LB misconfig.

mike_sales: Deploy bot shows `stable@2026-11-21T10:40Z` earlier today. They were running baseline flow, no heavy concurrency. sample req: req_ar_99c.

ravi_engineer: I can tail worker logs and the model pool. Can you paste a curl reproducer? Also what model are they pinned to?

mike_sales: Reproducer: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x...' -d '{"prompt":"Summarize order 1234"}'` Model: rwd-1.2-large pinned in tenant settings.

ops_oncall: Checking pool status... pool-beta workers=0, worker_crash_count=3 in last 5m. Node crash reason: oom_kill on worker_42. Rolling restart in progress.

nina_se: OOMs could be from sequence length explosion. Any long-context requests? Also check kv cache growth.

ravi_engineer: Found crash logs: `OOM killed process runner (rss 38GB)`. The model rwd-1.2-large is ~28GB but some batch + cache spikes pushed memory. We should evict KV cache and reduce batch size. I'll patch runtime config: `set runtime.pool.beta.max_batch_tokens=4096` for now and evict caches.

deploy_bot: [orchestrator] rolling restart of pool-beta started by ops.

claire_cs: Customer restarted demo and sees intermittent 200s now, but still occasional 503. They asked: will this happen in production? How to guarantee availability?

mike_sales: Customer is worried. Need an answer and proposal before post-demo call.

nina_se: Immediate mitigation: (1) keep smaller batch sizes and stricter per-tenant concurrency caps, (2) enable fallback model (rwd-1.1-small) for failures, (3) recommend Dedicated pool with reserve to the customer. We can present an SLA + Dedicated trial.

ops_oncall: Restart completed. pool-beta stable nodes=4. I've applied `max_batch_tokens=4096` and evicted KV caches. Watching for new OOMs.

ravi_engineer: Logs after restart show success for req_ar_99c:

```
[WORKER] 2026-11-21T10:45:22Z worker=43 tenant=aurora-retail req=req_ar_99c model=rwd-1.2-large status=200 lat_ms=210
```

claire_cs: Demo finished; customer accepted running a small reconciliation test. They still want guarantees. I'm scheduling a follow-up with pricing and Dedicated options.

mike_sales: Please add action items: (1) run a tuned load test on rwd-1.2-large with KV traffic+batching, (2) propose Dedicated sizing for their 99th pct peak, (3) change tenant pinned fallback to rwd-1.1-small for auto-failover.

nina_se: Will create RFC for runtime default batch limits and an automated evict-on-spike policy. Also documenting steps in the runbook.

mike_sales: Thanks everyone. Postmortem to OPS-1217 with actions assigned. :thumbsup:
